scope: All 10 files in the pinned Git tree, including .gitignore and the root README. Methods are grouped by operation; changing a key, page, radius, or hash algorithm does not create another method-family record.

status_definitions.replayed: A bounded local implementation independently reproduced a specified source output using pinned source files and declared LP inputs.
status_definitions.runnable_with_inputs: The source gives an executable rule and all exact inputs, but no local replay has been recorded.
status_definitions.missing_rule_or_input: The exact source rule or required source bytes are absent; a fresh test would make additional assumptions.

method_families.specific_cases: 43 rune keys in the ZIP applied to each of 58 source page files; the README wordlist omits the archive's final DIVINITY key.
method_families.rule_status: No original generator script is supplied. GP subtraction, page phase zero and uninterrupted rune advance are recovered from source output; 2,494/2,494 complete archived page–key strings reproduce.
method_families.finding_scope: All 58 archived pages and 43 keys reproduce completely; the fixed opening test on LP2-00–55 finds none of nine predeclared 12-rune openings among 21,285 comparisons. The source gives no numerical language score.
method_families.unresolved: Original generator source, exact plaintext scoring rule and any nonzero key phases are not supplied; complete-output reproduction does not establish a solved reading.

method_families.specific_cases: Two radii (zero-based GP index or GP prime value), each compared with nearest rounding and integer truncation; source output covers pages 0–56.
method_families.rule_status: README states round(2πR) mod 29, while both archived output files implement truncation. The local record exposes both rather than silently choosing one.
method_families.finding_scope: Both truncated variants reproduce every complete archived page output, 57/57 each. Nearest rounding does not. The prime-radius map reaches only 18 of 29 runes; no language criterion was supplied.
method_families.unresolved: The source interesting-result criterion remains unspecified. Frozen plan hashes describe CRLF checkout bytes; the pinned Git LF bytes and exact newline conversion are separately verified.

method_families.kind: Historical image/hash lookup, outside LP2 rune solving
method_families.specific_cases: The script calls sha512sum and b2sum on 75 original JPEGs and searches for the concatenated 128-hex-character page-56 target. The archived text contains 75 SHA-512 and 75 BLAKE2 rows and no literal target match.
method_families.rule_status: The 75 exact source JPEG bytes are identified by all 150 SHA-512/BLAKE2b-512 saved checksum entries. Both digest algorithms and target are specified and independently replayed.
method_families.finding_scope: None of 150 complete source-JPEG digests matches the LP2-56 target. A separately frozen follow-up on 58 seventh-onion JPEGs also finds 0/116 target matches; those different bytes are not represented as the source corpus.
method_families.unresolved: Neither byte set is independently authenticated as puzzle-creator originals. Other files, transformations, combined files and web-page hashing remain outside this specified lookup.
